preconditions.description: The number of stations n is between 3 and 3000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= xi <= n and 1 <= yi <= n for xi, yi in edges)
preconditions.description: Each station index xi and yi is between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: xi != yi for xi, yi in edges
preconditions.description: No station is connected to itself.

preconditions.expression: all((xi, yi) not in edges and (yi, xi) not in edges for (xi, yi) in edges)
preconditions.description: There is no more than one passage between any pair of stations.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n numbers.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(d, int) for d in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each number in the output is an integer.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= d <= n-1 for d in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each number in the output is between 0 and n-1.
At least one station is on the ringroad.

postconditions.expression: all(d == 0 or (d > 0 and any((i, j) in edges or (j, i) in edges for i, j in zip(return_value.index(d-1), return_value.index(d)))) for d in set(return_value))
postconditions.description: Stations with distance d are directly connected to stations with distance d-1.
